images.alt: Two identical text strips enter a box; one is partly taken from a shelf of stored slices, the other read fresh. Their exit paths fork and wind through a grid of small tool icons to different endpoints.
images.prompt: Two identical paper strips of text enter a box from the left, one above the other. Inside the box the upper strip's first half is pulled from a shelf of stored slices while the lower strip is read fresh from start to end. On the right the two strips exit and their paths fork apart, winding through a small grid of tool icons along different routes and ending at different points. The box sits in the centre with generous margin on all sides.

images.alt: Five identical small robots each standing in a differently shaped doorway, with a bar of a different height above each doorway.
images.prompt: One small identical robot figure drawn five times in a row across the middle of the frame, each standing inside a differently shaped doorway: an arch, a square frame, a narrow slot, a wide gate, a plain opening. Above each doorway a vertical bar of a different height, from very short to tall. The robots are identical; only the doorways and bars differ. Centred with margin on all sides.

images.alt: A math worksheet between two reviewers: a mirror-image figure with a big stamp and a tall reject pile on the left, a different figure with a pen and a short pile on the right.
images.prompt: In the centre a worked sheet of handwritten math on a desk. Two reviewers lean in from either side. On the left, a figure that is a mirror image of the writer's own silhouette holds a large stamp beside a tall pile of rejected sheets. On the right, a differently shaped figure holds a small pen beside a short pile, with one neat correction mark on the sheet. Keep both figures well inside the frame.

images.alt: Two phone screens side by side, the left crowded with boxes, the right sparse, with a column of check marks and crosses between them and a small rule card below.
images.prompt: Two versions of the same phone screen side by side in the centre: the left one crowded with many small boxes and buttons, the right one with three well spaced elements and open space. Between them a thin vertical strip of small check marks and crosses, like a diff column. Below the pair, a single small card with a short list of ticked rules. Everything sits within the middle two thirds of the frame.

images.alt: A looping conveyor with two robots passing a box and a stopwatch above it, and beneath it a single large button with a short arrow to the same box.
images.prompt: A long winding conveyor track loops across the middle of the frame, with two small robot figures at separate stations handing a small box from one to the other, and a stopwatch hanging above the track. Directly beneath the track, one large round push button on a plain panel, with a short straight arrow from the button to the same box at the end of the track. Keep all elements away from the edges.

images.alt: A very tall stack of paper next to a single small index card with three numbered lines, the third circled, and reading glasses resting on the card.
images.prompt: A tall stack of printed pages, taller than the desk it sits on, occupies the left-centre of the frame. Beside it on the right, a single small index card with three numbered lines, the third line circled. A pair of reading glasses rests on the card, not on the stack. Composition centred with generous margins.
